findings.current: ，其中包含{elsewhere, plural, other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off}个非活跃对话}}
findings.problem: Appended with no separator to the shipped label 全部{count}个标为已读, the accessible name reads 全部3个标为已读，其中包含1个非活跃对话. The wording is faithful and 其中 correctly marks the subset, but 其中包含 hangs off a verb phrase that has already closed; a predicate clause after 其中 (其中N个为非活跃对话) reads more smoothly as a screen-reader tail and states the subset relation the same way. The identical clause also appears inside scope_chats_elsewhere, so a change there must be made in both keys.
findings.suggested: ，其中{elsewhere, plural, other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off}个为非活跃对话}} (same edit inside scope_chats_elsewhere)

observations.remark: 完成回执 for 'completion token' is accepted. No glossary row or style-guide term exists for this third sense of token (the zh-CN guide keeps Latin 'token' for LLM tokens and 令牌 for auth tokens), and 回执 matches this catalogue's receipt family: ui.hub.status.receipt 操作回执：{operation}, ui.chat.canonical.tool_row.bridge.delivery.unconfirmed.note 确认回执丢失了, ui.chat.canonical.fold.receipt.* 唤醒回执/其他回执. It follows the context note's 'translate descriptively, never as a security token' and reads plainly inside 有N个未读标记没有完成回执，无法清除。 If a term closer to 'token' is ever preferred, 完成凭据 is the only candidate; 完成令牌 would collide with the auth-token sense and is wrong here.

非活跃对话 for 'not active' is the plain backend class and names no section (the sidebar's sections are time-based: Running/Today/This week/Older), as the context note requires. 其中包含 preserves that the elsewhere count is a subset of count, never an addition.

{chats}{tokenless} with no separator is correct for zh-CN: scope_chats and scope_chats_elsewhere each end in the full-width 。 and scope_tokenless begins a new sentence, so the two run together properly (将5个未读对话标为已读。有1个未读标记没有完成回执，无法清除。). A space would violate the guide's no-space rule between Han runs and would be visible as a gap; the English single space is correctly dropped.

Pre-existing, unchanged by this PR (the diff adds only the five mark_all_read keys): structurally, zh prints its count through an explicit {badge, number, ::group-off} inside the plural where en prints the implicit #, so the two locales format the same badge number by different rules (en leaves grouping to the plural's default formatting; zh pins it off). Why that happened is not knowable from this diff; recorded for the manager, not a finding against this delta, and no rendered output was observed.

Pre-existing and unchanged: at count=1 the visible label renders 全部1个标为已读, mirroring English 'Mark all 1 read'. The awkwardness is in the source count invariant (the control only shows at >=1 unread), not introduced here; the accessible-name tail composes cleanly onto it.
